rules.stable_fact: eligible only when verified and not requiring current verification; pending audit, no vector ingestion
rules.historical_fact: date-bound reference only in this wave; no general embeddings
rules.dynamic_operational_fact: live authority verification, never stable retrieval
rules.conflicted_fact: show conflict with source alternatives; no selected value or general embeddings
rules.authority_sensitive_fact: specialist authoritative review; no general embeddings

live_fallback: State that current information is unverified; consult competent official authority. Do not fabricate operational answers.
conditional_access_rule: Access chunks describe geography only; any itinerary/action request must also apply conditions_claim_ids and live verification.
